subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should these 14 exact action revisions be approved as one grouped privileged workflow update after the branch is refreshed against current main?
rationale: The patch changes third-party code executed with repository, registry, GitHub App, and OpenAI credentials; source provenance and acceptable grouped blast radius require an accountable human decision.

options.title: Verify and land together
options.body: Rebase or recreate the PR, review all upstream compare ranges and exact SHAs, then merge the group after exact-head workflow gates pass.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate token-, publishing-, CodeQL-, and Codex-bearing actions from lower-privilege setup actions to reduce review and rollback blast radius.

options.title: Defer and recreate
options.body: Close only after a maintainer decides the stale unrefreshable branch is not worth repairing and asks Dependabot to open a fresh update.

recommendation.title: Verify and land together
recommendation.body: Rebase or recreate the PR, review all upstream compare ranges and exact SHAs, then merge the group after exact-head workflow gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release and workflow history plus direct PR engagement make this person the best available owner for the grouped security-boundary decision.
